newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippine 9-month coconut exports down 40.9 pct.
newsitem.headline: Philippine 9-month coconut exports down 40.9 pct.

text.p: Philippine nine-month coconut exports fell by 40.9 percent to 1.064 million tonnes from 1.801 million tonnes in the same period last year, the United Coconut Associations of the Philippines Inc (UCAP) said on Thursday.
For the month of September alone, coconut exports dipped by 37 percent to 107,568 tonnes from 170,730 tonnes in September 1995.
UCAP said the decline in exports from January to September was a result of an across-the-board drop in exports of coconut products. Coconut oil exports decreased by 41.9 percent to 596,095 tonnes.
The freight-on-board (FOB) value of coconut exports for the first three quarters of the year fell 27.8 percent to $528.547 million from $731.681 million, UCAP said.
For September, the FOB value of coconut exports fell 31.9 percent to $51.191 million.
